title: Checkmarx One AI Supply Chain Security
description: Checkmarx AI Supply Chain Security (AI SCS) gives CISO, security and development teams complete visibility and control over AI components in their software supply chain. Integrated directly into the Checkmarx One platform, it uncovers hidden AI assets (LLMs, agents, MCP servers, frameworks) evaluates AI-specific risks like insecure deserialization, dangerous model loaders, shell execution, suspicious pickle/torch gadget patterns, enforces governance through your existing AppSec workflows and generates AI-BOM.
